t: Create Brand Boards from Color Picker in Emails
html:
You can now create a Brand Board directly from the Email Builder without leaving your email. This article explains how the feature works and walks you through creating your first Brand Board and using its colors right away.

What is the Creating a Brand Board from Color Picker?


The Create Brand Board feature lets you set up your brand colors, fonts, and logos directly from the Email Builder's color picker.

Instead of opening a new tab, you can create your Brand Board in a pop-up window while working on your email.

You can:

  • Import from a URL: Bring in brand colors, fonts, and logos from your website.

  • Choose a preset: Start with a ready-made brand style.

  • Start from blank: Create your own Brand Board from scratch.


Only brand colors are required. Fonts and logos are optional. Once saved, your brand colors become available immediately in the color picker.

How to Create a Brand Board from the Email Builder


Note: The Create Brand Board option only appears if you don't already have a Brand Board. If one exists, you can access its saved colors directly from the color picker.


  1. Go to Marketing > Emails > Templates and create a new template or edit an existing one.

  2. In the Email Builder, open any color picker and click Create Brand Board.

  3. Choose to Import from URL, select a preset style, or Start from blank.

  4. Add or review your brand colors. Optionally, add fonts and logos using the Font and Logo tabs.

  5. Click Save to create your Brand Board.

  6. Return to the color picker and select your saved colors under Brand Colors.
